gitlab-foundations.title: 1-bosqich - Asoslar
gitlab-foundations.description: CI/CD nima, GitLab buni qanday qiladi va har bir pipeline tuzilgan beshta komponent: fayl, pipeline’lar, stage’lar, job’lar, runner’lar. Oxirida job log’ini o’z tilidek o’qiysiz va artifact’lar hamda needs bilan ko’p job’li pipeline yozasiz.

gitlab-pipeline-configuration.title: 2-bosqich - Pipeline konfiguratsiyasi
gitlab-pipeline-configuration.description: Job’lar qachon va qanday ishlashini boshqarish: har darajadagi o’zgaruvchilar, predefined o’zgaruvchilar, job va workflow darajasidagi rules, schedule’lar, resource group’lar, timeout’lar, image’lar, service’lar va parallel matrix.

gitlab-continuous-integration.title: 3-bosqich - Continuous integration
gitlab-continuous-integration.description: Haqiqiy ilova - XYZ jamoasining Node.js servisi - testlanadi, hisobot beriladi, image’ga yig’iladi, registry’ga publish qilinadi va template’lar, cache hamda merge request pipeline’lari bilan tuzilmaga keltiriladi.

gitlab-continuous-deployment.title: 4-bosqich - Continuous deployment
gitlab-continuous-deployment.description: GitLab ko’radigan environment’lar, manual gate’lar bilan SSH orqali deploy, himoya va rollback bilan staging’dan production’ga ko’tarish yo’li, har merge request uchun review app’lar va Kubernetes’ga deploy.

gitlab-optimisation-security.title: 5-bosqich - Optimallashtirish va xavfsizlik
gitlab-optimisation-security.description: Tez, modulli va xavfsiz pipeline’lar: critical path’ni o’lchash, parent-child va multi-project pipeline’lar, CI/CD component’lar, o’rnatilgan xavfsizlik skanerlari va pipeline’ning o’zini himoya qilish.

gitlab-runners-auto-devops.title: 6-bosqich - Self-managed runner’lar va Auto DevOps
gitlab-runners-auto-devops.description: O’z runner’laringizni ishga tushirish - o’rnatish, ro’yxatdan o’tkazish, tag’lar, config.toml, executor’lar, mustahkamlangan deploy runner - va Auto DevOps: GitLab yaratadigan pipeline, uni sozlash va qachon o’zingiznikiga o’tish kerakligi.

1.title: 1-hafta - CI/CD, GitLab va birinchi pipeline’ingiz
1.description: XYZ jamoasining muammosi, atamalar, akkaunt va loyiha, hamda ataylab buzadigan pipeline.

2.title: 2-hafta - Runner’lar, stage’lar, artifact’lar va needs
2.description: Job’ni kim bajaradi va u qanday izolyatsiya qilinadi; ishni tartiblash; fayllarni oldinga uzatish; va job’larni stage qulfidan ozod qiladigan DAG.

3.title: 3-hafta - O’zgaruvchilar, rules, schedule’lar va job boshqaruvi
3.description: Pipeline qaror qabul qilishni o’rganadigan hafta - va shu paytgacha o’tilgan har bir kalit so’zni sinaydigan ikkita lab.

4.title: 4-hafta - XYZ ilovasini testlash
4.description: Lokal npm test’dan to hech kim log ochmasdan yiqilgan testlar va coverage’ni ko’rsatadigan merge request’gacha.

5.title: 5-hafta - Build, publish va tuzilma
5.description: CI’da build qilingan va SHA bilan publish qilingan image’lar; hech narsani buzmay tezlashtiradigan cache’lar; template’lar, include’lar va merge request pipeline’lari.

6.title: 6-hafta - Environment’larga deploy
6.description: Bitta image dev, staging va production orqali ko’tariladi - avtomatik, tugma bilan va qo’riqchi ortida.

7.title: 7-hafta - Tezroq, modulli, xavfsizroq pipeline’lar
7.description: Kamroq kutish, kamroq takror, kamroq kutilmagan hol - va pipeline’ning o’zini suiiste’mol qilishni qiyinlashtiradigan nazoratlar.

8.title: 8-hafta - O’z runner’laringiz va Auto DevOps
8.description: YAML o’zgarmaydi; u qayerda ishlashi o’zgaradi. So’ng butun yo’nalish - generatsiya qilingan holda - va yakuniy loyiha.

gitlab-course-introduction.title: Kursga kirish va XYZ muammosi
gitlab-course-introduction.summary: XYZ jamoasiga nega pipeline kerak, CI, continuous delivery va continuous deployment nimani anglatadi va sakkiz hafta qanday tuzilgan.

gitlab-cicd-basics.title: CI/CD asoslari va pipeline anatomiyasi
gitlab-cicd-basics.summary: Stage’lar, job’lar, runner’lar va trigger’lar - har bir pipeline’ning umumiy shakli va job aslida nima.

gitlab-account-and-project.title: GitLab akkaunt, guruh, loyiha va pipeline editor
gitlab-account-and-project.summary: gitlab.com’ni sozlang, kurs resurslarini import qiling va pipeline’lar hamda job log’lari qayerda yashashini o’rganing.

gitlab-core-components.title: GitLab CI/CD asosiy komponentlari
gitlab-core-components.summary: .gitlab-ci.yml, pipeline’lar, stage’lar, job’lar, runner’lar va executor’lar - va beshtasi orqali o’qilgan job log’i.

gitlab-first-pipeline.title: Oddiy pipeline yaratish va ishga tushirish
gitlab-first-pipeline.summary: Uchta job’li pipeline, ataylab buzish, Retry va yangi pipeline farqi, va istalgan job’da ishga tushiradigan beshta buyruq.

gitlab-runners-and-executors.title: Runner va executor turlari
gitlab-runners-and-executors.summary: Instance, group va project runner’lar; shell, docker va kubernetes executor’lar; SaaS parki boshidan oxirigacha qanday ishlaydi.

gitlab-shared-runners-and-scripts.title: Shared runner’lar, before_script va fayldagi skriptlar
gitlab-shared-runners-and-scripts.summary: Shared runner’larda ishlating, vositalarni halol o’rnating va uzun skriptlarni repozitoriyga ko’chiring.

gitlab-stages-and-dependencies.title: Stage’lar, stage va stages farqi, bog’liq job’lar
gitlab-stages-and-dependencies.summary: Stage’lar bilan tartiblash, 'bog’liq' aslida nima degani va stage’lar nega bepul emas.

gitlab-artifacts.title: Artifact’lar - job ma’lumotlarini saqlash
gitlab-artifacts.summary: Fayllarni keyingi job’lar va odamlarga uzating: paths, expire_in, dependencies, when:always - va cache nega boshqa narsa.

gitlab-needs-dag.title: needs kalit so’zi va DAG pipeline’lar
gitlab-needs-dag.summary: Bog’liqliklar tugashi bilan job’larni boshlang; needs va artifact’lar; optional needs; qachon ishlatmaslik kerak.

gitlab-variables.title: Har darajadagi o’zgaruvchilar, masking va himoya
gitlab-variables.summary: Instance’dan job’gacha ustuvorlik, File turidagi o’zgaruvchilar, masking nima qiladi va nima qilmaydi, himoyalangan va scope’langan sirlar.

gitlab-predefined-variables.title: Predefined CI/CD o’zgaruvchilari
gitlab-predefined-variables.summary: Har bir job boshlanadigan o’zgaruvchilar va ular asosida qurilgan namunalar.

gitlab-merge-requests-and-rules.title: Merge request’lar va job darajasidagi rules
gitlab-merge-requests-and-rules.summary: if, changes, exists, when va allow_failure - job mavjud bo’lish-bo’lmasligini va qanday bo’lishini hal qilish.

gitlab-workflow-rules-and-schedules.title: workflow:rules, pipeline schedule’lar va pipeline’ni o’tkazib yuborish
gitlab-workflow-rules-and-schedules.summary: Pipeline umuman mavjud bo’lishini hal qiling, tunda ishlarni bajaring va pipeline’ni ataylab o’tkazib yuboring.

gitlab-job-controls.title: Resource group, timeout, image, service va parallel matrix
gitlab-job-controls.summary: Bir vaqtda bitta deploy, chegaralangan job’lar, testlar yonida ma’lumotlar bazasi va bitta ta’rifdan N ta job.

gitlab-nodejs-app-overview.title: XYZ Node.js ilovasi
gitlab-nodejs-app-overview.summary: Ilovani lokal ishga tushiring va testlang, uni pipeline’ga tayyor qiladigan uchta narsani tekshiring.

gitlab-designing-the-ci-pipeline.title: XYZ pipeline’ini loyihalash
gitlab-designing-the-ci-pipeline.summary: Stage’lar, har bir rule ortidagi qaror, import va siz to’ldiradigan skelet.

gitlab-unit-testing-in-ci.title: Pipeline’da unit testlash
gitlab-unit-testing-in-ci.summary: npm ci, toolchain’ni qotirish, integratsion testlar uchun service va shartnoma sifatida exit kodlar.

gitlab-test-reports-and-coverage.title: Merge request’da test hisobotlari va coverage
gitlab-test-reports-and-coverage.summary: JUnit, coverage regex va Cobertura - yiqilishlar va coverage reviewer’lar aslida qaraydigan joyda.

gitlab-allow-failure-and-lint.title: Job yiqilishini e’tiborsiz qoldirish va linting
gitlab-allow-failure-and-lint.summary: allow_failure va exit kod aniqligi, code quality hisobotlari va manual gate tuzog’i.

gitlab-docker-build-in-ci.title: Pipeline’da Docker image build qilish
gitlab-docker-build-in-ci.summary: Docker-in-Docker, kaniko va shell daemon; takrorlanadigan, cache’langan Dockerfile.

gitlab-container-registry.title: GitLab Container Registry’ga publish
gitlab-container-registry.summary: Job-token bilan login, tag strategiyasi, bir marta build qilib ko’tarish, cleanup policy’lar.

gitlab-cache-vs-artifacts.title: Cache - va u artifact’lardan qanday farq qiladi
gitlab-cache-vs-artifacts.summary: Lock fayl bo’yicha key, policy’lar, fallback key’lar va yo’q cache nega hech qachon job’ni buzmasligi kerak.

gitlab-templates-extends-include.title: Template’lar: yashirin job’lar, extends, default va include
gitlab-templates-extends-include.summary: Takrorni yo’q qiling va pipeline’ni versiyalab, ulashib bo’ladigan fayllarga bo’ling.

gitlab-merge-request-pipelines.title: Merge request pipeline’lar, merged results va train’lar
gitlab-merge-request-pipelines.summary: Har MR uchun bitta pipeline, merge natijasini testlash va yig’ilgan MR vidjeti.

gitlab-environments.title: Environment’lar va deploy’lar
gitlab-environments.summary: environment:name/url/tier, environment scope’li o’zgaruvchilar va deploy job’ining to’liq shakli.

gitlab-deploy-to-a-server.title: Manual gate’lar bilan SSH orqali serverga deploy
gitlab-deploy-to-a-server.summary: File o’zgaruvchi sifatida SSH kalit, tekshirilgan host key’lar, serverda job-token bilan registry login va bloklovchi manual job.

gitlab-staging-production.title: Staging, production, himoya va rollback
gitlab-staging-production.summary: Ko’tarish yo’li, himoyalangan environment’lar va approval’lar, rollback va revert, delayed job’lar.

gitlab-review-apps.title: Review app’lar - har merge request uchun environment
gitlab-review-apps.summary: Dinamik environment’lar, on_stop, auto_stop_in va View app tugmasi.

gitlab-deploy-to-kubernetes.title: Kubernetes’ga deploy
gitlab-deploy-to-kubernetes.summary: kubeconfig o’zgaruvchisi va GitLab agent farqi, kubectl va helm, registry’dan pull qilish.

gitlab-pipeline-efficiency.title: Pipeline samaradorligi
gitlab-pipeline-efficiency.summary: Critical path’ni o’lchang; kamroq ishga tushiring, tezroq boshlang, har job’da kamroq qiling, sekinni bo’ling, tez yiqiling.

gitlab-parent-child-pipelines.title: Parent-child va multi-project pipeline’lar
gitlab-parent-child-pipelines.summary: trigger:include, strategy:depend, job tomonidan generatsiya qilingan dinamik child’lar va boshqa loyihaga uzatish.

gitlab-cicd-components-and-catalog.title: CI/CD component’lar va katalog
gitlab-cicd-components-and-catalog.summary: Tipli input’larga ega, tag bilan versiyalangan va topiladigan template’lar - shartnomali include.

gitlab-security-scanning.title: Pipeline’da xavfsizlik skanerlash
gitlab-security-scanning.summary: Include sifatida SAST, secret detection, dependency va container scanning va hisobotlar qanday gate’ga aylanadi.

gitlab-protecting-the-pipeline.title: Pipeline’ni himoya qilish
gitlab-protecting-the-pipeline.summary: Himoyalangan ref’lar, o’zgaruvchilar va environment’lar, minimal huquqli token’lar, pipeline’da CODEOWNERS va fork xavfsizligi.

gitlab-self-managed-runner-install.title: Self-managed runner o’rnatish va ro’yxatdan o’tkazish
gitlab-self-managed-runner-install.summary: Linux’da gitlab-runner, authentication token’lar, tag’lar va scope.

gitlab-runner-executors-config.title: Runner executor’lari va config.toml
gitlab-runner-executors-config.summary: concurrent va limit, privileged, volume’lar, pull policy, umumiy cache va mustahkamlangan deploy runner.

gitlab-auto-devops-overview.title: Auto DevOps - siz yozmagan pipeline
gitlab-auto-devops-overview.summary: Auto DevOps nimani generatsiya qiladi, unga nima kerak va qachon o’zini oqlaydi.

gitlab-auto-devops-customize.title: Auto DevOps’ni sozlash
gitlab-auto-devops-customize.summary: O’zgaruvchilar, template’ni include qilib job’larni override qilish, o’z chart’ingiz va u o’zini oqlamay qo’yadigan chegara.

gitlab-capstone-and-next-steps.title: Yakuniy loyiha - yig’ilgan XYZ pipeline va keyingi qadamlar
gitlab-capstone-and-next-steps.summary: Sakkiz haftaning tekshiruv ro’yxati sifatida o’qilgan yakuniy pipeline va bundan keyin qayerga borish.
